# Original upstream 0.51.0 release

Unmodified assets from https://github.com/skopevoj/spoti.pw/releases/tag/v0.51.0.
The release supports Spotify 9.1.90 and 9.1.78. SHA-256 values match GitHub's release asset digests:

- Kit: `21587c2b9433e3482c8c0ca6c6e4c7325a4b2c76d69bed607dfb031791231bd8`
- DEB: `68a9030cff5e514e7b6549e70e8237a7e42a889269d7be9fe932f44f9fa0c584`

The kit is the default input to `make release-optimized` and `make release-official`.
Our performance add-on is built separately and does not modify these upstream assets.
The earlier 0.50.0 assets remain in the neighboring directory for provenance and rollback.
